The input loading, launch geometry, multi-stage scratch schedule, and final copy remain unchanged, so the overall timing may still be dominated by traffic or launch overhead.

items.subject: Isolate and improve the CTA-local reduction
items.objective: In src/candidate.cu, isolate the CTA-local reduction: replace reduce0's modulo-based shared-memory tree with a warp-centric or permitted CUB block reduction, while keeping the 128-thread launch geometry, one input per lane, multi-stage scratch schedule, and final copy fixed. The existing warpReduceSum helper is not currently used by reduce0, so it is a natural comparison point, not a measured improvement. Handle tails safely and preserve exact signed sums. Validate all checks and compare complete-run timings; report whether the local change helps independently of launch topology.
